# Ahmed Wafaey

> Applied AI product leader based in Berlin. Takes frontier AI from demo to production in messy, multi-market businesses. Languages: English, Arabic, German.

## Current
- Delivery Hero: Senior Director of Product, Growth & AI, Quick Commerce (Jul 2022 – present). 7 brands, 4 domains, 17 squads, 75 countries. Quick commerce grew from 4% to 12% of GMV contribution. Leads the AI practice for the teams.
- ProductVoyagers Labs (founder, 2024 – present): fustat.ai (AI evaluation of product design against business goals; 20 customers in first month), korba.ai (AI browser where people and agents work side by side), telos (open-source Claude Code plugin).
- rituals.pm (co-founder, 2025 – present): AI PM Builders cohorts in English and Arabic; open-source pm-os and claude-101.
- Instructor on LLMs, agents and Claude (Maven, Zomra); writes Product Voyagers (productvoyagers.com).

## Previous
- Wayfair, Product Lead Internationalization (2021–2022): ML localization protecting $1.6B annual revenue.
- Careem / Uber, Lead PM Super App (2020–2021): 48M users.
- Boeing Data Analytics Labs, Sr. Strategic PM (2018–2020): data marketplace for 150+ operators.
- Ericsson (2011–2018), Nokia, Etisalat, ITWorx (software engineer, 2006): enterprise telecom systems.

## Education
- Executive MBA, Durham University Business School

## Best fit
Applied / forward-deployed AI product roles; agentic commerce and growth; AI deployment across EMEA and MENA.
